scene: You emerge into a bustling sky-transit dock overlooking Pixel City.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the sky-dock platform. Far left, a solar-sail junk floats moored to a wooden post. Center, a maglev dragon train sits open on elevated rails. To the right stands the Pacific Islander man with top knot and ukulele. Far right hangs a suspended cloud cable pod with an open hatch.

a serpentine dragon-headed maglev waiting with open doors in the centre
